executive_summary: During Fiscal Week 202719, the Combined Queue Brazil OOP SITEL (Forecast Name Brazil OOP) recorded an actual offered volume of 920 contacts against a forecast of 742 contacts, resulting in a 24% under-forecast (actual above forecast). Voice (Brazil OOP) demand increased by 281 contacts week-over-week (from 639 to 920); no other channels were present, so the total demand for the queue rose by 281 contacts. This increase reflects a genuine rise in Voice demand across the Americas region, not a shift between channels. Because the Regional forecast for Americas/CSG under-estimated demand (adherence -12.6%), the same under-forecast propagated to the Brazil OOP queue, causing the forecast to miss the actual spike.
business_impact: Under-staffing risk for Voice support in Brazil, potentially leading to longer wait times and service level breaches.
